inicio.heroTexto: Open from seven to nine. Fresh bread and toast in the morning, burgers and suckling pig at lunch, and a counter full of cakes all day — half of it vegan.

combinacoes.texto: Six pairs printed at the bottom of our menu. Not a best-seller list — just what goes well with what.

vegan.proporcao: {vegan} of our {total} menu items are vegan — not a shelf on the side, but half the house.

festas.texto: Three tiers, three sizes, one fixed price. Savoury and fried miniatures, mini pizzas, cheese boards, meat breads — and the sweet half, which is where we come from.

fotografia.texto: The bread, the pastries, the chocolates, and the dish of the day. The photographs are the house's own — each one carries its mark.
fotografia.credito: Photographs by Confeitaria e Pão Quente Damira.

legendas.pao: Freshly baked village loaves on the counter.
legendas.tartes: Strawberry tartlets being assembled on a tray.
legendas.bombons: Gold-wrapped chocolates lined up on a platter.
legendas.almoco: A plate of grilled fish with vegetables, from the lunch menu.

fecho.texto: Over the counter every day, seven to nine. For a party, with a phone call first.

casa.direcoes: Tap to open in Google Maps.
casa.horarioPorConfirmar: Daily hours still to be confirmed. If you are coming from far, call ahead.
casa.semHorario: Opening hours to be confirmed. Until then, calling is safest.

ementa.intro: Four menus: the everyday counter, the weekend lunch, the vegan one, and the chocolate.

casa.texto: What is on the counter every day, from seven to nine: light bites, hot savouries, pastries, and drinks.

fim-de-semana.texto: At weekends there are plates. Bairrada-style suckling pig, steak plate — and the burgers from the house menu keep coming out.

vegan.texto: Pastries, savouries, and whole cakes, all vegan. A menu of its own, not a shelf of exceptions.

chocolate.texto: Made here, in four sizes, from a pocket square to a half-kilo bar.

notas.batata: The burgers, chicken toastie, and sandwiches marked on the menu come with potatoes.
notas.sabores: Ask at the counter which flavours we have today.
notas.palhinhas: Try your drink with our edible straws, for €1 more.
notas.iva: VAT included at the applicable rate.
notas.alergenios: Allergen information is available in the shop — just ask.
notas.precos: Prices from the 2025 and 2026 menus, to be confirmed.

encomendas.intro: Parties, custom cakes, and boxes for special days. All of it is ordered ahead — it is not what sits on the counter.

festas.texto: Three tiers at a fixed price, for twenty, forty, or seventy people. Pick how many you are and compare what each one includes.

kitsBolo.texto: The cake with the rest of the table to match: decorated biscuits, cupcakes, cakesicles, and brigadeiros.
kitsBolo.nota: Delivery and setup are not included in the price.

boxes.texto: A closed box to take away: breakfast in bed, a birthday tea, or a visit to someone close by.

como.texto: By phone or by email. Tell us what you want, for how many people, and for which day — we reply with a quote and a confirmation.
como.prazo: Minimum notice is still to be confirmed. Call us and we will tell you right away whether your date works.

formulario.texto: Tell us what you want, for how many people, and for which day. We reply with the price and a confirmation — there is no payment on this page.
formulario.nota: No payment, no automatic booking. Your order is confirmed only when we reply.

campos.tipo: What would you like to order
campos.umDosDois: Either one will do — it is how we reply.
campos.detalhePlaceholder: A chocolate cake with red berries, for 15 people, with the name “Matilde” on top.
campos.consentimento: I agree that my details may be used to answer this request. They are not used for anything else, nor shared.

erros.sem-contacto: Leave an email or a phone number — without one we cannot reply.
erros.detalhe-curto: Tell us a little more about what you need.
erros.consentimento: We need this permission in order to reply to you.

sucesso.texto: We will reply with a quote and confirm the date. If it is urgent, call us — that is always faster.

semServico.texto: Automatic sending is not switched on for this site yet. Your request is written and ready: open it in your email app and press send.

bolos.texto: The sponge, the filling, the topping, what goes on top, and what goes around it. That is {classica} choices on the classic line and {vegan} on the vegan one.
bolos.semPrecos: The price of a custom cake depends on weight, filling, and decoration — we quote it by phone, with your request in front of us. Catalogue cakes do have prices, on the menu.

metadata.imagemAlt: The storefront of Confeitaria e Pão Quente Damira in Ermesinde, with the sign and the words “Histórias com sabor” painted on the glass.

inicio.titulo: Confeitaria e Pão Quente Damira — Ermesinde, since 1996
inicio.descricao: Bakery, pastry shop, and kitchen in Ermesinde, Portugal. Fresh bread and a full counter every day, 7am to 9pm. A complete vegan menu, party kits, and cakes to order.

ementa.descricao: The Confeitaria e Pão Quente Damira menu: light bites and savouries over the counter, weekend lunch, a full vegan menu, and Dubai Chocolate.

encomendas.descricao: Party kits for 20, 40, or 70 people, custom decorated cakes, and boxes for special days, at Confeitaria e Pão Quente Damira in Ermesinde.
